- Investigation timeline: once a dispute is filed, investigations are typically completed within about 45 business days (may extend to 90 days in special cases, such as international transactions).  
- If provisional credit is granted, it’s usually applied within a few business days after filing. If the investigation concludes in your favor, the credit becomes permanent; if not, any provisional credit would be reversed with prior notice.
